tickets.title: US001
tickets.description:
As a Student,
I want to order food from my phone,
so that I can avoid waiting in line.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Student can browse menu items.
- Student can place an order.
- Confirmation is displayed.

tickets.title: US002
tickets.description:
As a Student,
I want allergy filters,
so that I only see safe food options.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Allergy filters can be selected.
- Unsafe items are hidden.
- Filter settings remain active during browsing.

tickets.title: US003
tickets.description:
As a Student,
I want sold-out items hidden,
so that I do not attempt to order unavailable food.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Sold-out items are marked.
- Sold-out items cannot be ordered.
- Menu updates immediately.

tickets.title: US004
tickets.description:
As a Kitchen Staff member,
I want to mark items as sold out instantly,
so that customers receive accurate availability information.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Staff can update availability.
- Changes appear immediately.
- New orders are blocked.

tickets.title: US005
tickets.description:
As a Marketing Staff member,
I want to send promotional notifications,
so that students are informed about special offers.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Notifications can be scheduled.
- Notifications are delivered successfully.
- Students receive the promotion message.

analysis.ambiguity1:
Requirement:
Reduce the queue.

Explanation:

The requirement does not specify a measurable target. It is unclear how much reduction is expected and how success will be evaluated.
analysis.ambiguity2:
Requirement:
Offering them a discount.

Explanation:

The discount amount, eligibility conditions, duration, and limitations are not specified.
analysis.conflictSolution:
No direct stakeholder conflict was identified.

Proposed Solution:

Prioritize allergy filtering and order management features because they directly affect student safety and cafeteria operations.
analysis.nfr1:
Reliability
The kitchen display system must continue operating during temporary internet outages.
analysis.nfr2:
Performance
Orders should appear on the kitchen display within seconds after submission.
analysis.nfr3:
Usability
Students should easily filter menu items based on allergies.
